turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This is Elena, recording our week one walk. Marco, you're okay being recorded?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So the demo's done and the old soffit is gone.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Right, the cans go where the soffit was, eight of them like the plan.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: If you want the bigger tile, the four by twelve, that's a small upcharge, I'll write it up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay, send me the change order.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Cabinets arrive on the 14th and we'll have the doors on by the 21st.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can we move the island outlet to the end panel?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure, moving that outlet is no charge.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Great. That's the walk for this week.
